reviews.comment:
Me parece una verguenza una marca Argentina que nos representa a todos en un lugar estratégico camino a corrientes capital, gente de brasil, cerca de posadas, los baños todos sucios, personal no preparado para atender la gente y mantener la limpieza del predio (la gente deberia ayudar) donde la gente hace un descanso de su viaje.....ni hablar que en esta época te cobren el agua 10 pesos para tomar el mate.....

(Translated by Google)
I think it's a disgrace that an Argentinian brand, which represents us all, is in such a strategic location on the road to Corrientes, the capital city. It's near Posadas, with Brazilian tourists, filthy bathrooms, and staff who aren't trained to serve customers or maintain the cleanliness of the premises (people should help out). It's a place where people take a break from their travels... not to mention that they charge 10 pesos for water to make mate at this time of year...
